Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 70: May 2007
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #70 shipped to subscribers in April 2007 (bearing the cover date of May 2007 for Issue 70). Continuing OXM's Xbox 360-exclusive lineup, Disc #70 featured native high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trial games, and exclusive media content:

Guitar Hero II (rhythm-action music simulation)
Armored Core 4 (high-speed tactical mech combat)
Virtua Tennis 3 (arcade tennis simulation)
TMNT (Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles) (action-adventure brawler)
LUXOR 2 (Xbox Live Arcade action-puzzle game)
3D Ultra Minigolf Adventures (Xbox Live Arcade arcade sports)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc delivered custom dashboard themes, gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video features—including previews for upcoming 2007 blockbusters like Mass Effect, BioShock, Forza Motorsport 2, and Blue Dragon, alongside OXM's monthly Top Plays segment.
